74500.meaning1: fact of pride; fact of conceit; state of comparing oneself

74501.meaning1: leading to full awakening; going to enlightenment
74501.commentary: (ITIa) sambodhī'ti ariyañāṇaṃ, taṃ gacchanti bhajantī'ti sambodhigāmino, bodhipakkhikā'ti attho.

examples.text: yassa dhammā subhāvitā, satta sambodhigāmino, taṃ ve kalyāṇadhammo'ti, āhu bhikkhuṃ anussadaṃ.

74502.meaning1: who has given up everything; who has abandoned all

examples.text: tehi dhammehi sampannaṃ, anīghaṃ chinnasaṃsayaṃ, asitaṃ sabbalokassa, āhu sabbapahāyinan'ti.

74503.commentary: (ITIa) avaṇṇayī'ti kittayi, bhojanaṃ, bhikkhave, dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ pañca ṭhānāni detī'ti-ādinā (a. ni. 5.37), evaṃ ce, bhikkhave, sattā jāneyyuṃ dānasaṃvibhāgassa vipākan'ti-ādinā (itivu. 26) ca pasaṃsayi.

examples.text: yam'āhu dānaṃ paramaṃ anuttaraṃ, yaṃ saṃvibhāgaṃ bhagavā avaṇṇayi, aggamhi khettamhi pasannacitto, viññū pajānaṃ ko na yajetha kāle.

74504.meaning1: compassionate for all beings; sympathetic to all living beings

examples.text: yo dhammayāgaṃ ayajī amaccharī, tathāgato sabbasatt'ānukampī, taṃ tādisaṃ devamanussaseṭṭhaṃ, sattā namassanti bhavassa pāragun'ti.

74505.meaning1: knowledge of liberation; understanding of release
74505.commentary: (ITIa) gāthāsu vimuttiñāṇan'ti vimuttiyaṃ nibbāne phale ca paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ.

examples.text: tato aññā vimuttassa, vimuttiñāṇam'uttamaṃ, uppajjati khaye ñāṇaṃ, khīṇā saṃyojanā iti.

evarūpā ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū satthāro'ti'pi vuccanti, satthavāhā'ti'pi vuccanti, raṇañ'jahā'ti'pi vuccanti, tamonudā'ti'pi vuccanti, ālokakarā'ti'pi vuccanti, obhāsakarā'ti'pi vuccanti, pajjotakarā'ti'pi vuccanti, ukkādhārā'ti'pi vuccanti, pabhaṅ'karā'ti'pi vuccanti, ariyā'ti'pi vuccanti, cakkhumanto'ti'pi vuccantī'ti.

evarūpā ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū satthāro'ti'pi vuccanti, satthavāhā'ti'pi vuccanti, raṇañ'jahā'ti'pi vuccanti, tamonudā'ti'pi vuccanti, ālokakarā'ti'pi vuccanti, obhāsakarā'ti'pi vuccanti, pajjotakarā'ti'pi vuccanti, ukkādhārā'ti'pi vuccanti, pabhaṅ'karā'ti'pi vuccanti, ariyā'ti'pi vuccanti, cakkhumanto'ti'pi vuccantī'ti.

74508.meaning1: creating joy; bringing happiness; causing gladness
74508.commentary: (ITIa) gāthāsu pāmojjakaraṇaṃ ṭhānan'ti nirāmisassa pamodassa nibbattakaṃ ṭhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ.

examples.text: pāmojjakaraṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ, etaṃ hoti vijānataṃ, yadidaṃ bhāvit'attānaṃ, ariyānaṃ dhammajīvinaṃ.

74509.meaning1: dependent on one another; mutually supported
74509.commentary: (ITIa) ubho añño'ññanissitā'ti te ubho'pi aññam'aññasannissitā. sāgārā hi anagārānaṃ dhammadānasannissitā, anagārā ca sāgārānaṃ paccayadānasannissitā.

examples.text: sāgārā anagārā ca, ubho añño'ññanissitā, ārādhayanti saddhammaṃ, yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ.

74510.meaning1: removing the risks; protecting from danger

examples.text: sāgāresu ca cīvaraṃ, paccayaṃ sayan'āsanaṃ, anagārā paṭicchanti, parissayavinodanaṃ.
sugataṃ pana nissāya, gahaṭṭhā gharamesino, saddahānā arahataṃ, ariyapaññāya jhāyino.

74512.meaning1: pleasant and beautiful; lovely and alluring
74512.commentary: (ITIa) piyarūpasātarūpenā'ti piyasabhāvena sātasabhāvena ca kāraṇabhūtena, tassaṃ nadiyaṃ tassā vā paratīre maṇisuvaṇṇ'ādi aññaṃ vā piyavatthu vitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ atthi, taṃ gahessāmī'ti nadiyaṃ patitvā sotena avakaḍḍheyya.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito disvā evaṃ vadeyya, kiñ'c'āpi kho tvaṃ, ambho purisa, nadiyā sotena ovuyhasi piyarūpasātarūpena, atthi c'ettha heṭṭhā rahado saūmi sāvaṭṭo sagaho sarakkhaso yaṃ tvaṃ, ambho purisa, rahadaṃ pāpuṇitvā maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti.

74514.commentary: (ITIa) vimuttiyā phassaye tattha tatthā'ti tasmiṃ tasmiṃ maggaphal'ādhigamanakāle vimuttiṃ nibbānaṃ phassaye phuseyya pāpuṇeyya adhigaccheyya sacchikareyya. upayog'atthe hi vimuttiyā'ti idaṃ sāmivacanaṃ. vimuttiyā vā ārammaṇabhūtāya tattha tattha taṃtaṃphalasamāpattikāle attano phalacittaṃ phassaye phuseyya pāpuṇeyya, nibbān'ogadhāya phalasamāpattiyā vihareyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: sahā'pi dukkhena jaheyya kāme, yogakkhemaṃ āyatiṃ patthayāno, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, vimuttiyā phassaye tattha tattha, sa vedagū vūsitabrahmacariyo, lok'antagū pāragato'ti vuccatī'ti.

74515.meaning1: detached from the entire world; disentangled from everything
74515.commentary: (ITIa) sabbalokavisaṃyutto'ti catunnaṃ yogānaṃ anavasesappahānena sabbena'pi lokena visaṃyutto vippamutto.

examples.text: sabbalokaṃ abhiññāya, sabbaloke yathātathaṃ, sabbalokavisaṃyutto, sabbaloke anūpayo.

74519.meaning1: prolonged existence; long-standing; endurance for an extended time

74521.grammar: pr, from na pakāsati, neg, intrans (+instr)
74521.meaning1: is not evident; does not manifest; does not appear (because of)
74521.construction:
na + pa + kāsa + ti
na + pakāsati

examples.text: niddā tandī vijambhitā, aratī bhattasammado, etena nappakāsati, ariyamaggo idha pāṇinan'ti.
addasā kho bhagavā sambahule kumārake antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca jetavanaṃ ahiṃ daṇḍena hanante.

74523.commentary: (UDa) yaṃ me vijātāya bhavissatī'ti yaṃ tel'ādi mayhaṃ vijātāya bahinikkhantagabbhāya upakārāya bhavissati.

examples.text: atha kho sā paribbājikā taṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca, gaccha tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, telaṃ āhara, yaṃ me vijātāya bhavissatī'ti.

74525.commentary: (MNa) cittappaṭibaddhā'ti cittanissitā, citte sati honti, asati na honti.

examples.text: pubbe kho, āvuso visākha, vitakketvā vicāretvā pacchā vācaṃ bhindati, tasmā vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro. saññā ca vedanā ca cetasikā ete dhammā cittappaṭibaddhā, tasmā saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāro'ti.

74526.synonym: utta, udīrita, pabhāvita, pavutta, bhaṭṭha, bhaṇita, bhāsita, lapita, vutta
74526.commentary: (UDa) so tassa vasalavādo dīgharattaṃ samudāciṇṇo'ti yo eta'r'ahi khīṇ'āsavena'pi satā pavattiyati, so tassa vacchassa bhikkhuno vasalavādo dīgharattaṃ ito jātito paṭṭhāya uddhaṃ ārohanavasena pañcajātisatamattaṃ kālaṃ brāhmaṇajātikattā samudāciṇṇo samudācarito ahosi. brāhmaṇā hi jātisiddhena mānena thaddhā aññaṃ vasalavādena samudācaranti. ajjhāciṇṇo'ti'pi paṭhan'ti, so eva attho.

examples.text: vacchassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pañca jātisatāni abbokiṇṇāni brāhmaṇakule paccājātāni. so tassa vasalavādo dīgharattaṃ samudāciṇṇo. ten'āyaṃ vaccho bhikkhū vasalavādena samudācaratī'ti.

74528.grammar: fem, abstr, comp, from na bhāvitatta, neg
74528.meaning1: fact of being unawakened; fact of not being self-developed
74528.construction:
na > a + bhāvita + atta + tā
abhāvitatta + tā

74529.meaning1: fact of being awakened; fact of being self-developed

74530.commentary: (UDa) cālike pabbate'ti tassa nagarassa avidūre eko pabbato, so'pi sabbasetattā kālapakkhauposathe olokentānaṃ calamāno viya upaṭṭhāti, tasmā cālikapabbato'ti saṅkhaṃ gato. tattha bhagavato mahantaṃ vihāraṃ kārayiṃsu, bhagavā tadā taṃ nagaraṃ gocaragāmaṃ katvā tasmiṃ cālikapabbatamahāvihāre viharati. tena vuttaṃ, cālikāyaṃ viharati cālike pabbate'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā cālikāyaṃ viharati cālike pabbate. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā meghiyo bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.

74533.meaning1: knocks into the earth; makes sink into the ground
74533.commentary: (UDa) osādeyyā'ti pathaviyaṃ osīdāpeyya nimujjāpeyya. osāreyyā'ti'pi pāṭho, cuṇṇavicuṇṇaṃ kareyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: tāva mahā pahāro ahosi, api tena pahārena sattaratanaṃ vā aḍḍh'aṭṭhamaratanaṃ vā nāgaṃ osādeyya, mahantaṃ vā pabbatakūṭaṃ padāleyya.

74534.grammar: pr, irreg form of ramati, intrans (+loc)
74534.meaning1: enjoys; finds pleasure; takes delight (in); likes
74534.commentary: (DNa) yattha me ramatī mano'ti yattha me mano ramissati, tatth'eva khattiyakul'ādīsu gabbhaṃ upagacchissāmī'ti sattakkhattuṃ deve ca mānuse cā'ti imam'atthaṃ dīpeti.

examples.text: cut'āhaṃ diviyā kāyā, āyuṃ hitvā amānusaṃ, amūḷho gabbhamessāmi, yattha me ramatī mano.
etaṃ nāgassa nāgena, īsādantassa hatthino, sameti cittaṃ cittena, yad'eko ramatī mano'ti.

74535.meaning1: who has heightened mental faculties; (comm) arahant
74535.commentary: (UDa) adhicetaso'ti adhicittavato, sabbacittānaṃ adhikena arahattaphalacittena samannāgatassā'ti attho.
74535.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: adhicetaso appamajjato, munino monapathesu sikkhato, sokā na bhavan'ti tādino, upasantassa sadā satīmato'ti.

74536.meaning1: fully mentally developed; possessing higher consciousness

74537.meaningLit: to be done by a man

examples.text: apagatā ime sāmaññā, apagatā ime brahmaññā. kathañ'hi nāma puriso purisakiccaṃ karitvā itthiṃ jīvitā voropessatī'ti!

74539.commentary: (VINa) paccabyattha padam'asokan'ti yaṃ mayaṃ pariyesamānā vicarāma, taṃ padam'asokaṃ paṭividdhāttha tumhe, pattaṃ taṃ tumhehī'ti attho.

74540.commentary: (UDa) pavatte pabbate'ti pavattanāmake pabbate. papāte pabbate'ti'pi paṭhan'ti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākaccāno avantīsu viharati kuraraghare pavatte pabbate. tena kho pana samayena soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo āyasmato mahākaccānassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.

74541.commentary: (UDa) ekavihāre'ti ekagandhakuṭiyaṃ. gandhakuṭi hi idha vihāro'ti adhippetā.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, yassa kho maṃ bhagavā āṇāpeti, imass'ānanda, āgantukassa bhikkhuno sen'āsanaṃ paññāpehī'ti, icchati bhagavā tena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthuṃ, icchati bhagavā āyasmatā soṇena saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthun'ti.

74542.commentary: (UDa) pāpe na ramatī sucī'ti suvisuddhakāyasamācār'āditāya visuddhapuggalo rājahaṃso viya ukkāraṭṭhāne pāpe saṃkiliṭṭhadhamme na ramati n'ābhinandati. pāpo na ramatī sucin'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, pāpo pāpapuggalo suciṃ anavajjaṃ vodānadhammaṃ na ramati, añña'd'atthu gāmasūkar'ādayo viya ukkāraṭṭhānaṃ asuciṃ saṃkilesadhammaṃ'y'eva ramatī'ti paṭipakkhato desanaṃ parivatteti.

examples.text: disvā ādīnavaṃ loke, ñatvā dhammaṃ nirūpadhiṃ, ariyo na ramatī pāpe, pāpe na ramatī sucī'ti.
tass'ovādakarā bahugihī ca pabbajitā ca, asuciṃ garahitaṃ dhunanti pāpaṃ, sa hi sucibhi parivuto bhavati, malakhilakalikilese panudehī'ti.

74543.grammar: abs of ussukkāpeti, deno of ussukka, caus, trans (+acc)
74543.meaning1: having made an effort; having tried
74543.constructionSummary: ud + su + ka + ya + āpe + tvā
74543.construction: ud + su + ka + ya + āpe + tvā
74543.commentary: (VIBHt) ussukkāpetvā'ti uddhaṃ uddhaṃ santivisesayuttaṃ katvā, vaḍḍhetvā'ti attho.

examples.text: ek'āyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā, sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, vīriyaṃ ārabhatha appattassa pattiyā, anadhigatassa adhigamāya, asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.

74545.meaning1: (of the community) causes a schism (in); splits apart
74545.commentary: (UDa) devadatto saṅghaṃ bhindissatī'ti bhedakarānaṃ sabbesaṃ devadattena sajjitattā ek'aṃsen'eva devadatto ajja saṅghaṃ bhindissati dvidhā karissati. adhammaṃ dhammo'ti-ādīsu hi aṭṭhārasasu bhedakaravatthūsu yaṃkiñci ekam'pi vatthuṃ dīpetvā tena tena kāraṇena imaṃ gaṇhatha, imaṃ rocethā'ti saññāpetvā salākaṃ gāhetvā visuṃ saṅghakamme kate saṅgho bhinno hoti.

examples.text: ajja, bhante, devadatto saṅghaṃ bhindissati, uposathañ'ca karissati saṅghakammāni cā'ti.

74546.commentary: (UDa) sukaraṃ sādhunā sādhū'ti attano paresañ'ca hitaṃ sādhetī'ti sādhu, sammāpaṭipanno. tena sādhunā sāriputt'ādinā sāvakena paccekabuddhena sammāsambuddhena aññena vā lokiyasādhunā sādhu sundaraṃ bhaddakaṃ attano paresañ'ca hitasukhāvahaṃ sukaraṃ sukhena kātuṃ sakkā.

examples.text: sukaraṃ sādhunā sādhu, sādhu pāpena dukkaraṃ, pāpaṃ pāpena sukaraṃ, pāpam'ariyehi dukkaran'ti.

74547.meaning1: man blind from birth; birth-blind person

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, imissā'y'eva sāvatthiyā aññataro rājā ahosi. atha kho, bhikkhave, so rājā aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, yāvatakā sāvatthiyā jacc'andhā te sabbe ekajjhaṃ sannipātehī'ti.

74548.commentary: (VVt) sabbā sammajjanī'ti nāḷikerahīr'ādīhi baddhā yaṭṭhisammajjanī, muṭṭhisammajjanī'ti duvidhā pariveṇ'aṅgaṇ'ādisammajjanī ca tath'eva duvidhā khajjūrināḷikerapaṇṇ'ādīhi baddhā gehasammajjanī cā'ti sabbā'pi sammajjanī garubhaṇḍaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yehi, bhikkhave, jacc'andhehi hatthissa vāladhi diṭṭho ahosi, te evam'āhaṃsu, ediso, deva, hatthī seyyathā'pi sammajjanī'ti.

74549.meaning1: passing beyond the bond; escaping the tie
74549.commentary: (UDa) taṃ saṅgam'aticca arūpasaññī'ti ettha nti nipātamattaṃ. atha vā hetuattho taṃsaddo. yasmā anavasesena micchāvitakkā samucchinnā, tasmā rāgasaṅg'ādikaṃ pañcavidhaṃ saṅgaṃ, sabbam'pi vā kilesasaṅgaṃ aticca atikkamitvā atikkamanahetu rūpasabhāv'ābhāvato ruppanasaṅkhātassa ca vikārassa tattha abhāvato nibbikārahetubhāvato vā arūpan'ti laddhanāmaṃ nibbānaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā pavattāhi maggaphalasaññāhi arūpasaññī.

examples.text: yassa vitakkā vidhūpitā, ajjhattaṃ suvikappitā asesā, taṃ saṅgam'aticca arūpasaññī, catuyog'ātigato na jātu m'etī'ti

74550.commentary: (UDa) āpātaparipātan'ti āpātaṃ paripātaṃ, āpatitvā āpatitvā paripatitvā paripatitvā, abhimukhapātañ'c'eva paribbhamitvā pātañ'ca katvā'ti attho. āpāthe paripātan'ti keci paṭhan'ti, āpāthe padīpassa attano āpāthagamane sati paripatitvā paripatitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā adhipātakā tesu telappadīpesu āpātaparipātaṃ anayaṃ āpajjanti, byasanaṃ āpajjanti, anayabyasanaṃ āpajjanti.

74551.commentary: (UDa) āpātaparipātan'ti āpātaṃ paripātaṃ, āpatitvā āpatitvā paripatitvā paripatitvā, abhimukhapātañ'c'eva paribbhamitvā pātañ'ca katvā'ti attho. āpāthe paripātan'ti keci paṭhan'ti, āpāthe padīpassa attano āpāthagamane sati paripatitvā paripatitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā adhipātakā tesu telappadīpesu āpātaparipātaṃ anayaṃ āpajjanti, byasanaṃ āpajjanti, anayabyasanaṃ āpajjanti.
ucchinda sineham'attano, kumudaṃ sāradikaṃ'va, santimaggam'eva brūhaya, nibbānaṃ sugatena desitaṃ.

74553.commentary: (SNPa) tattha rañjanavasena rāgo, pañcakāmaguṇarāgass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. udacchidā'ti ucchindati, bhañjati, vināseti. atītakālikānam'pi hi chandasi vattamānavacanaṃ akkharacintakā icchanti.

examples.text: yo rāgam'udacchidā asesaṃ, bhisapupphaṃ'va saroruhaṃ vigayha, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'ivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

74554.commentary: (SNPa) māno'ti jātiādivatthuko cetaso uṇṇāmo. so seyyo'ham'asmī'ti māno, sadiso'ham'asmī'ti māno, hīno'ham'asmī'ti māno'ti evaṃ tividho hoti. puna seyyassa seyyo'ham'asmī'ti, seyyassa sadiso, seyyassa hīno, sadisassa seyyo, sadisassa sadiso, sadisassa hīno, hīnassa seyyo, hīnassa sadiso, hīnassa hīno'ham'asmī'ti māno'ti evaṃ navavidho hoti… ādinā nayena tattha ādīnavapaccavekkhaṇena vuttappakārehi sīlasaṃvar'ādīhi ca yo thokaṃ thokaṃ vadhento kilesānaṃ abaladubbalattā naḷasetusadisaṃ lok'uttaradhammānaṃ atibalattā mah'oghasadisena arahattamaggena asesaṃ udabbadhi, anavasesappahānavasena ucchindanto vadhetī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yo mānam'udabbadhī asesaṃ, naḷasetuṃ'va sudubbalaṃ mah'ogho, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'ivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

74555.meaning1: with food cooked; with meal prepared

examples.text: pakk'odano duddhakhīro'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi āhito gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

74556.grammar: pr 2nd sg of patthayati, irreg form of patthayasi, trans (+acc)
74556.commentary: (SNPa) atha ce patthayasī'ti idāni yadi icchasī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: pakk'odano duddhakhīro'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi āhito gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
andhakamakasā na vijjare, kacche rūḷhatiṇe caranti gāvo, vuṭṭhim'pi saheyyum'āgataṃ, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

74558.commentary: (SNPa) bhisī'ti pattharitvā puthulaṃ katvā baddhakullo vuccati loke. ariyassa pana dhammavinaye ariyamaggass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: baddhā'si bhisī susaṅkhatā, tiṇṇo pāragato vineyya oghaṃ, attho bhisiyā na vijjati, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

74559.commentary: (SNPa) dīgharattaṃ saṃvāsiyā'ti dīghakālaṃ saddhiṃ vasamānā komārabhāvato pabhuti ekato vaḍḍhitā. tena parapurise na jānātī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: gopī mama assavā alolā, dīgharattaṃ saṃvāsiyā manāpā, tassā na suṇāmi kiñci pāpaṃ, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

74561.meaning1: adverting; turning towards; directing towards; inclining

74567.commentary: (ITIa) tasmā antam'idaṃ bhikkhave jīvikānan'ti bhikkhave idaṃ jīvikānaṃ antaṃ pacchimaṃ lāmakaṃ, sabbanihīnaṃ jīvitan'ti attho.

examples.text: paṃsukūlan'ti rathikā-susāna-saṅkārakūṭ'ādīsu yattha katthaci paṃsūnaṃ upari ṭhitattā abbhuggat'aṭṭhena paṃsukūlaṃ viyā'ti paṃsukūlaṃ, paṃsu viya kucchitabhāvaṃ ulati gacchatī'ti paṃsukūlan'ti evaṃ laddhanāmaṃ rathik'ādīsu patitanantakāni uccinitvā katacīvaraṃ.
atthi vasā atthi dhenupā, godharaṇiyo paveṇiyo'pi atthi, usabho'pi gavampat'īdha atthi, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

74572.commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.1) ubbhatasmiṃ kathine'ti aṭṭhannaṃ mātikānaṃ aññatarāya mātikāya ubbhataṃ hoti, saṅghena vā antarā ubbhataṃ hoti.

examples.text: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine das'āhaparamaṃ atirekacīvaraṃ dhāretabbaṃ, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine ekarattam'pi ce bhikkhu ticīvarena vippavaseyya, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

74575.commentary: (UDa) vidvā pajahāti pāpakan'ti tena vedagūbhāvena vidvā jānanto pāpakaṃ abhaddakaṃ attano dukkh'āvahaṃ pajahāti, pāpakaṃ vā akalyāṇapuggalaṃ pajahāti.

examples.text: diṭṭhena ce suddhi narassa hoti, ñāṇena vā so pajahāti dukkhaṃ, aññena so sujjhati sopadhīko, diṭṭhī hi naṃ pāva tathā vadānaṃ.
na kāmasukham'anuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca atta-kilamatha-anuyogam'anuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.

74577.meaning1: eye sense organ; visual sense base

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, ādittapariyāyo, dhammapariyāyo? varaṃ, bhikkhave, tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhu'ndriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

74578.meaning1: ear sense organ; auditory sense base

examples.text: varaṃ, bhikkhave, tiṇhena ayosaṅkunā ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena sot'indriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva sotaviññeyyesu saddesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

74579.meaning1: nose sense organ; olfactory sense base

examples.text: varaṃ, bhikkhave, tiṇhena nakhacchedanena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena ghān'indriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva ghānaviññeyyesu gandhesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.
varaṃ, bhikkhave, tiṇhena khurena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena jivh'indriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

74581.meaning1: body sense organ; tactile sense base

examples.text: varaṃ, bhikkhave, tiṇhāya sattiyā ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya kāy'indriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva kāyaviññeyyesu phoṭṭhabbesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho. nimitt'assādagathitaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, anubyañjan'assādagathitaṃ vā tasmiñ'ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya.

74582.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; Sāriputta's sister
74582.commentary: (THIa) tassā nāmaggahaṇadivase cālā'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu, tassā kaniṭṭhāya upacālā'ti, atha tassā kaniṭṭhāya sīs'ūpacālā'ti. imā tisso'pi dhammasenāpatissa kaniṭṭhabhaginiyo, imāsaṃ puttānam'pi tiṇṇaṃ idam'eva nāmaṃ. ye sandhāya theragāthāya cāle upacāle sīsūpacāle'ti (theragā. 42) āgataṃ.
74582.notes: Therīgāthā verses 182-188 (TH7.2, TH59) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ cālā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

74586.grammar: pp of na pātubhavati, comp, neg
74586.construction:
na > a + pātu + bhūta
na + pātubhūta
74586.commentary: (ANa) abhāvitaṃ apātubhūtan'ti ayaṃ viseso. tatrāmayadhippāyo, vaṭṭavasena uppannacittaṃ nāma uppannam'pi abhāvitaṃ apātubhūtam'eva hoti. kasmā? lok'uttarapādaka-jjhāna-vipassanā-magga-phala-nibbānesu pakkhandituṃ asamatthattā. vivaṭṭavasena uppannaṃ pana bhāvitaṃ pātubhūtaṃ nāma hoti. kasmā? tesu dhammesu pakkhandituṃ samatthattā. kurundakavāsī phussamittatthero pan'āha, maggacittam'eva, āvuso, bhāvitaṃ pātubhūtaṃ nāma hotī'ti.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ abhāvitaṃ apātubhūtaṃ mahato anatthāya saṃvattati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ. cittaṃ, bhikkhave, abhāvitaṃ apātubhūtaṃ mahato anatthāya saṃvattatī'ti.

74587.meaning1: bad deeds; wickedness; evil actions; wrongdoing

katame pañca? idha, gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno pamād'ādhikaraṇaṃ mahatiṃ bhogajāniṃ nigacchati. ayaṃ paṭhamo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
kuto pan'assa, bhante, dussīlassa pāpadhammassa evarūpo sīlasaṃyamo bhavissatī'ti?
